profile.headline: Software Engineer on Oculus Browser
profile.summary: A full-stack web developer, VR enthusiast, and games engineer with a background in laboratory work and the sciences. In addition to my experience in virtual worlds, on the web, and in the natural world, I also enjoy studying history, art, and further biology education, and I also apply myself to analysis and modeling. I am enthusiastic about learning how things work (whether in interactive systems, the mind, or the world) and enjoy applying what I know to my professional career.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack web developer at Wargaming

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: A short-term business project retailing safe, standardized viewing lenses for the 2017 North American Solar Eclipse. As co-founder of the business, I took part in all parts of project management, including financing, operations, logistics, client relations, and quality control. It was a successful project that brought this rare astronomical event safely to many viewers.

positions.title: QA Specialist
positions.description: Played a central role in many aspects of procedure development, document management, and maintaining compliance with regulations. I also designed, tested, and managed projects in software development, including designing and writing database applications and applications for process automation and documentation for manufacturing using SQL, C#, and Visual Basic .NET.

positions.title: Training Specialist
positions.description: Created and implemented a formal training program for the Medical Device Reprocessing department. The highly technical positions in this department required high precision and understanding of validation and quality principles.

positions.title: Lab Analyst
positions.description: A laboratory analyst in Medical Device Reprocessing department handles a cleaning validation for medical devices through written soiling, cleaning/disinfecting, and bioburden extraction procedures, following strict documentation practices and maintaining all GLP guideliness.
